title: Fisher Habitat
description: The fisher habitat harvest impact classes the block overlaps, and the layout advice for denning and resting trees.

sources: route card: Fisher Harvest Impact Warning

then.template: Block overlaps fisher habitat {classes} polygons developed by the BC Fisher Habitat Working Group.

then.text: If there are areas identified during layout with high numbers of large diameter cottonwood (>90cm dbh), Aspen (>44cm dbh), Douglas Fir (>65 cm dbh), live Pine (>35cm dbh), or Spruce (>27cm dbh) with rust brooms within the block layout crews should try to tie these areas into WTRAs when feasible to provide denning and resting habitat for fishers.
Block does not overlap with any fisher habitat 'caution' or 'warning' polygons developed by the BC Fisher Habitat Working Group.
